reviews.text: Dropped off a dog that I dog sitting for for the July 4 weekend. They do an excellent job of taking care of dogs who are afraid of firework noises.

I cannot recommend S & S Family Pet Hospital highly enough. We recently had to say goodbye to our beloved cat, Daisy, and the entire team handled a devastating day with the utmost grace, gentleness, and dignity.
This exceptional care is nothing new for them. For the past 18 years, I have brought all of my pets to this clinic. From the compassionate receptionists at the front desk to the patient vet technicians and the incredibly skilled doctors, every single staff member treats your animals like their own family.
Finding a veterinary team that you can trust completely for nearly two decades is rare. They offer unmatched expertise combined with genuine empathy. Thank you all for your unwavering dedication to my pets over the years, and for helping us through Daisy’s final moments. You are truly the best.

The team at S&S really care about animals! They gave our little pup the best start in life! Thank you to the gracious team for taking her in and caring for her! You have the best crew there and it’s so clear that you always go above and beyond!
The staff and vets at S&S Family Pet Hospital are absolutely fantastic!  There is a love for animals that is obvious from the moment you step inside. Highly recommend.

They truly care about their clients and their owners I cannot express how much I appreciate doctor Smith and his team they are friendly professional and saved my dogs life.  Even though I live 40 min away I will still continue to take all my pets there!

my cat was throwing up and losing weight. i make just over minimum wage and used most of my money for this visit. he was able to get everything he needed done and some, and i was helped substantially in terms of money. the doctors and nurses here genuinely care about animals over money and it shows! they ensure you will get the care you need regardless of your means. i will be a returning customer for sure. thank you for all of the help today at Basils appointment.

My cat turns 8 today, and I’m so grateful she’s here to celebrate this milestone thanks to Dr. Smith and the team. A few years ago, she faced a serious health issue that many vets might not have attempted to treat, but Dr. Smith took it on with skill and compassion and kept me updated all the way. Because of his care, she not only survived but has thrived—and I get to enjoy every year with her. I’ll always be thankful for the dedication and expertise that gave my girl a second chance. I have not taken my pets anywhere else since.
Dr. Smith and Dr. Shedd Garza are EXCEPTIONAL veterinarians.  The entire staff is knowledgeable and caring. I highly recommend  S&S Family Pet Hospital if your pet is in need of care.

We started going to S&S years ago when we lived near the office. They were recommended by a groomer we trusted. Have always gotten excellent service from staff and doctors.
We’ve since moved and still make the trek to S&S for the same friendly services and people. Highly recommend them to all our friends
Been taking the family pets here for a few years now! The staff is always friendly and knowledgeable. Grooming and Health checkups! Always busy!

Dr. B and staff are great. Our three pups have been coming here for 5+ years. Service is always informative and friendly. We recently lost one of our pups due to heart failure and the staff assisted us every step of the way.
I have had nothing but compassionate and professional care given my dogs by both Dr Garza and Dr Smith. I highly recommend them for anyone needing a great veterinary practice.

My cat Gary had a lump on his neck that I was concerned about and my previous vet in SA was not good. But here, I had a terrific experience. The people that work here are gentle, kind, and considerate, especially if you're meeting them with that same energy. The process was smooth start to finish and they involved me in the explanation of possible symptoms and tests that they might incur, plus the bill was itemized and emailed to me! You can tell they are genuinely just trying to work with their clients and are by no means trying to pull a fast one. I am greatly appreciative of their honesty, dedication, and hard work. THANK YOU!

I’ve been going here for 11 years. All the staff are very kind and I really feel like they care about my pet’s wellbeing. We feel very well taken care of here and I couldn’t imagine going anywhere else.
Really nice vet office. Staff in lobby are super helpful. Vets take time to listen to my concerns and then problem solve.

I have been coming to S&S forever. I started in 2014 up to 2017. I moved away to a different state from 2017 to 2022. But as soon as I got back to San Antonio, I immediately returned to S&S with my late Doberman, Storm, whom the staff had known since I got her at 12 weeks of age. They now take care of my other two fur babies, Nova & Hope. I love S&S and will continue to go to them as long as I am in San Antonio.
Caring team! Saved our dogs life.  TWICE!!

For the past two years, I have entrusted my pets to this clinic, where we once received compassionate care. Unfortunately, that is no longer the case. Recently, my dog underwent surgery, and the experience was far from smooth. I understand …

I took my pets to S&S for eight years. Dr Smith and Dr Garza were amazing. Until this year, when our dogs puppy got sick and it’s been a horrible experience. The Dr that would see our puppy, would never call us back. Half the time we can’t …
We love this place. The staff is very friendly and they are always happy to see us and our pup.  It is very pricey, but we pay because our dog is comfortable with these people. …
